milestones.title: Relational Schema & Database Tools
driver_tasks: Authored SQLite schema with menu_items, table_sessions, and order_line_items
Seeded 14 authentic menu items including zero-stock test item (Crispy Buffalo Chicken Tenders)
Implemented atomic CRUD functions with parameterized queries
navigator_reviews: Audited quantity grouping in add_item_to_order to prevent duplicate item rows
Verified 12% VAT calculations on order subtotals
Enforced case-insensitive substring matching for allergen verification

milestones.title: Conversational FSM Engine & Local Qwen Tool Binding
driver_tasks: Implemented 5-state lifecycle (STATE_GREETING, STATE_MENU_BROWSING, STATE_TAKING_ORDER, STATE_REVIEW, STATE_CONFIRMED)
Constructed 8 JSON tool schemas for local Ollama function calling
Built tool dispatch loop handling multi-step queries without regex hardcoding
navigator_reviews: Identified context window overflow with default 4K buffer; increased num_ctx to 8192
Specified fallback receipt synthesis when model outputs tool calls without trailing message
Mandated stripping <think> tags from client outputs while retaining them in telemetry logs

milestones.title: Interface Construction & Real-Time Synchronization
driver_tasks: Built Rich terminal TUI with visual state badges and tables
Developed FastAPI tablet dashboard on localhost:8000 with real-time cart polling
Decoupled I/O through IOChannel abstraction per Lesson 6 Subtopic 6.5
navigator_reviews: Tested manual +/- quantity buttons with live SQLite synchronization
Verified atomic rollback in confirm_order_and_deduct_stock under concurrent modifications
Inspected responsive CSS layout across tablet and desktop aspect ratios

milestones.title: Edge-TTS Voice Audio Pipeline & Multimodal Refinement
driver_tasks: Integrated asynchronous Edge-TTS with Philippine English neural voice (en-PH-RosaNeural)
Added phonetic speech sanitizer converting currency (₱185 -> 185 pesos) and greetings (Mabuhay -> Mabu-HAI)
Built voice mute/unmute toggle with real-time status telemetry
navigator_reviews: Validated emoji removal prior to audio synthesis to prevent runtime audio clipping
Audited browser audio decoding and base64 transmission latency
Tested Web Speech microphone input across varied accents

milestones.title: Ultra-Aesthetic Kiosk Overhaul & Multi-View Navigation Architecture
driver_tasks: Architected 3-mode Kiosk Navigation Switcher (Visual Menu, AI Waiter, Split View)
Built responsive Visual Menu Catalog with food cards, allergen pills, stock chips, and quick add buttons
Engineered Interactive Dish Customization Modal with option checkboxes and kitchen notes
Implemented real-time search bar and multi-tag dietary filters (Dairy-Free, Gluten-Free, Nut-Free, In-Stock)
Added interactive Table Selector Dropdown (Table 1 to Table 8) and floating toast notification engine
navigator_reviews: Verified /api/cart/add atomic integration with SQLite and FSM state progression
Tested responsive rendering on tablet viewports confirming zero horizontal overflow
Validated UPHSD Maroon and Academic Gold visual harmony and contrast compliance
